description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.
